note: The blueprint's identifier prefixes, taken from Appendix A -- Complete Identifier Registry by Prefix, which the document names its allocation authority and which states that an identifier outside it is a defect. Single source of truth: four separate tools were each carrying their own hand-written copy of this list, and every one of them was missing nine registered prefixes, so every coverage figure they produced was optimistic. Derived once, read everywhere.

unregisteredButPresent.note: Present in the document with no Appendix A row. Appendix A calls that a defect in the document, not in this graph, so they are indexed rather than discarded -- dropping real content to satisfy a registry would be deciding a source question by omission.

illustrative.note: The worked example (a fictional bicycle manufacturer).
